Assignment: Module 8 (Linguistic Markup)

Overview: You will lemmatize and tag 10 consecutive words of your witness three ways (by hand, with spaCy, and with an AI model), compare the three in one table, and merge the best reading of each word into a TEI file.

Class time is work time. Read the lessons before class; the Friday session is for running the passes and building your merged file, so most of this assignment can be finished in the room.

Deadline: due Friday, October 30, by 11:00 PM.
